task.title: Brewing Coffee with SmartBrew X1
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to prepare a fresh cup of coffee safely.

taskbody.prereq: Ensure the machine is plugged in and the drip tray is properly positioned.

step.cmd: Fill the water reservoir with fresh, cold water up to the MAX line.
Place a cup under the coffee spout and press the Brew button.
step.info: The indicator light blinks while heating and stays solid when brewing starts.

taskbody.result: Your coffee is ready to serve.
